blocks.text: Binibining Pilipinas Katrina Anne Johnson scored an early win at the 2026 Miss International pageant in Japan when she received the “Miss Visit Japan” award. The international pageant shared the news on social media on Friday afternoon, Nov. 13, and showed photos of the Filipino delegate accepting the recognition.
